# libzip / zip_read_metadata_fuzzer

libzip's own fuzz target `zip_read_metadata_fuzzer` ([source](source/zip_read_metadata_fuzzer.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libzip (nih-at/libzip at 1d4b30ac).

open the input as an in-memory archive (ZIP_RDONLY) and call every metadata accessor per entry: zip_stat_index, external attributes, file comment, extra fields by index (local+central, <=64) and by 6 well-known IDs; every result is discarded.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libzip at commit 1d4b30ac.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Statements ([Statements.v](Statements.v))

**Blocked by the model.** On ordinary inputs each of these binaries opens files other than its input, which this release's model treats as an error, so every statement here is false in this model for that reason alone. The program is not at fault; the statements become meaningful when the model covers it.

| statement | in one line | status |
|---|---|---|
| `plain_halts` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | blocked by the model |
| `ubsan_halts` | on every input on which the UBSan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | blocked by the model |
| `asan_halts` | on every input on which the ASan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | blocked by the model |
| `asan_ubsan_halts` | on every input on which the ASan+UBSan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | blocked by the model |
| `asan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 2 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; ASan never fires; memory refused only when forced | blocked by the model |
| `ubsan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; UBSan never fires; memory refused only when forced | blocked by the model |
